entries.title: Complete Mobility Equipment Display

entries.title: Fixed Upright Crossarm Quintain Display
entries.description: One complete original fixed quintain-style camp display exterior. A wide crossed grounded base and four whole diagonal braces support a tall central post; the upper vertical spindle passes through a complete thick arm-head collar beneath a retaining cap. One whole elevated horizontal crossarm connects a broad shaped timber target board at one end and a genuine hanging-eye, alternating closed links and one complete shouldered sack at the opposite end. No weapon, projectile, person or old prop is imported. Unlike the old low horizontal-shaft two-seat seesaw, fixed three-front-arm wooden dummy, or rear-offset braced heavy-bag cantilever, the new whole structure centres on the vertical head/post and asymmetric two-ended arm relationship. One prop, zero scenes, three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Fixed artistic appearance only: no rig, animation, working rotation, striking action, training technique or efficacy, historical precision, balance, load, manufacture or equipment safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Arched Shell and Staggered Bridge Zither
entries.description: One newly authored whole static long arched zither appearance. A complete thin-walled soundbox shell has a true faceted barrel-arched top, thick sides and a broad finite flat bottom; two closed material end pieces complete its internal hollow chamber. Two continuous curved end bridges follow the actual soundboard. Fourteen independent complete two-foot triangular bridges are staggered diagonally along the board, each with a finite crown and its own continuous lengthwise string running from real rear pin across the rear bank and bridge to the front bank and pin. The bridges have genuine small open throats between their two material feet, not printed triangular symbols. New full numeric construction, not a scaled trapezoid dulcimer or changed count of transverse doubled strings: no twin uninterrupted central bridges, neck or membrane pot. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up, true horizontal-envelope-centred ground origin. One model, zero scenes. The internal chamber is modeled but not claimed visible in the hero. Generic simplified instrument appearance, not a historical replica or specification. Static only: bridge adjustment, string tension, tuning, regional authenticity, sound, acoustics, playability and manufacture are not verified.

entries.title: Fixed Open V Fold Gatehouse Book
entries.description: One original complete open pop-up-style gatehouse book in a single fixed artistic pose. A continuous thick open hard cover and spine carry two full sloped page blocks. Two whole thin paper facade panels meet along a genuine upright central V crease; each has a finite complete foot tab seated into its own page. Their lower cut edges form an actual empty arched doorway across the fold, while the upper cut edges form distinct crenellated tower/parapet silhouettes. It is not a closed-book set with a building placed on top, a printed castle image, or the old folded boat/lantern/fan recoloured. Every mesh is newly authored; no old architecture or paper mesh imported. One complete prop, zero scenes, seven closed solids, three opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, centred ground datum. Static fictional paper-art representation only: no readable text, unfolding or closing proof, rig, animation, paper engineering, manufacture, durability, protective or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed A Frame Trunnion and Ankle Holder Table
entries.description: One newly authored whole static A-frame inversion-table exterior in a fixed empty upright-rest presentation. Two full high A side frames with spread ties and front/rear crossmembers stand on four finite pads. A complete transverse trunnion shaft joins the high sleeves and one continuous long chamfered upholstered board with its full rear spine. A separate full lower extension leads to an actual foot-rest plate and a central bracket carrying two complete opposed ankle-roller rows, each with its own transverse axle and separate thick pads. Two entire curved side handrails root into the high sleeves and front frame legs. This is not a rotated old press bench, its seat/back replacement, low slant board or an oval mirror stand with a different face; all geometry is newly authored. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and actual whole horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One prop, zero scenes, no person. Static illustrative exterior only: no exercise guidance, inversion movement, therapy, medical benefit, suitability, body dimensions, actual restraint, locking, adjustment, stability, load capacity, manufacture or safety is modeled or verified.

entries.title: Fixed Drawplate and Windlass Drawing Bench
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed traditional metalworking drawbench-style exterior. Four complete grounded legs and two crossheads carry long separated guide rails. A full square fixed drawplate has one genuine circular empty through-bore above its entire cross-bed foot. A separate whole bridge carriage supports two long blunt open gripping halves and their common upright pin; a full rear lug joins a single continuous finite flat strap which runs toward and wraps partway around a transverse windlass barrel. Two complete bearing towers support the whole axle, broad barrel, both flanges and an outboard open three-spoke handwheel with a fixed grip. Unlike the old rope-forming bench, there are no three independent hook axes, three-hole separator, forming strands or far capture eye; unlike the old metal lathe there is no chuck, tail quill, cutting tool or cross-feed slide. All geometry is newly authored, not old bench components rearranged. One prop, zero scenes, no wire or workpiece. Four opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, Z up, actual horizontally centred bounds and grounded soles. Static illustrative appearance only: no wire reduction, pulling action, clamping, carriage travel, drum rotation, strap tension, gear ratio, material processing, manufacture, operation, load, ergonomic fit or machinery safety guarantee. entries.description: One original complete fixed walk-behind floor-scrubber visual prop. Not the old barrel vacuum with a different nozzle or a snow machine with its auger removed: the integrated front disc and low trailing sweep connect to one tank chassis, no long detached wand or discharge chute.
